intro: Poddy celebrates sculptural simplicity. A single material wraps every curve of its monolithic form, creating a chair that feels cohesive, endearing, and tailored for relaxed, everyday seating.

features.title: Sculptural form with a statement presence
features.text: Poddy’s bold, modern silhouette is defined by soft, continuous curves. Its monolithic profile creates visual impact while maintaining a clean, understated elegance suited to contemporary interiors.

features.title: Comfort-focused lounging for relaxed moments
features.text: Designed for unwinding, the chair offers well-balanced cushioning that supports without overwhelming. Poddy’s tailored fit ensures every sitting experience feels intentional, comfortable, and effortless.

features.title: Fully upholstered body for seamless luxury
features.text: A single upholstery material hugs every gracious curve, creating a cohesive and plush appearance. This seamless coverage enhances both visual softness and tactile comfort.

features.title: Tailored contours for ergonomic ease
features.text: The gently shaped back and seat are designed to cradle the body naturally. This thoughtful shaping enhances comfort while preserving the chair’s sculptural purity.

features.title: Smooth synthetic leather upholstery
features.text: Finished in synthetic leather, Poddy offers a refined, easy-to-maintain surface. The material balances durability with a soft, premium feel.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Poddy Synthetic Leather Fully Upholstered Lounge Chair
